newsitem.title: USA: Power Efficiency in talks with Chicago Natural Gas.
newsitem.headline: Power Efficiency in talks with Chicago Natural Gas.

text.p: Power Efficiency Corp said on Monday it was holding discussions with Chicago Natural Gas Inc, a privately-held distributor of natural gas and a developer and installer of cogeneration projects.

Chicago Natural has expressed interest in making an investment in Power Efficiency or establishing a joint marketing arrangement with it. Such an arrangement would allow the marketing of Power's products to Chicago's industrial and commercial customer base, the company said.
Power Efficiency said discussions were in the preliminary stage.
